defects_found.description: Large-PDF fetches (diputados.gob.mx-class sources) stall/hang mid-download past pg_net's ~120s caller timeout under v1.5.
defects_found.root_cause: v1.5 has no fetch-level timeout of its own (no AbortSignal) — a slow-drip download can run indefinitely on the worker side even after the pg_net caller has given up at 120s.
defects_found.fix_ref: commit 0735a410 (Wave F1b, capture-worker v1.6 — FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS 45s via AbortSignal.timeout() on both fetch calls) — authored, not yet deployed as of this run

defects_found.description: One invocation crashed with WORKER_RESOURCE_LIMIT after buffering a pathological PDF fully into memory before checking its size.
defects_found.root_cause: v1.5 reads the full response body before any size check — no pre-buffer guard against Content-Length.
defects_found.fix_ref: commit 0735a410 — pre-buffer size guard (MAX_PDF_BYTES 25MB unchanged, new MAX_TEXT_BYTES 50MB, checked against Content-Length before any body bytes are read) — authored, not yet deployed as of this run
